scope: Sourced canonical facts for the two new Game target keys introduced by this packet. The Wikipedia links point directly to English articles that cover the Wii U Yoshi title and the original Scott Pilgrim game plus its Complete Edition; exact game-key labels are preserved.

facts.evidence: The article credits Good-Feel as developer of the Wii U game.
The article credits Nintendo as publisher of the Wii U game.
The article lists Platform as the game genre.
The article identifies the original Yoshi’s Woolly World as a Wii U game; it treats the later Nintendo 3DS release as a separate port titled Poochy & Yoshi’s Woolly World.
The article identifies the Wii U game as a 2015 release.

profiles.game_key: Scott Pilgrim vs. The World: The Game – Complete Edition

facts.value: Engine Software (Complete Edition); Ubisoft Montreal and Ubisoft Chengdu (original game)
facts.evidence: The article credits Ubisoft Montreal and Ubisoft Chengdu for the original game and identifies Engine Software as the developer of the Complete Edition.
The article lists Ubisoft as publisher of the game and its Complete Edition.
The article lists Beat ’em up and action role-playing as genres.
The article says the original digital game launched on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in 2010; these are distinct from later Complete Edition platforms.
The article identifies the original release as August 2010.
The article lists these platforms for the Complete Edition re-release.
The article gives 14 January 2021 as the Complete Edition release date.
